data.content_ref: inline:Add an incremental maintenance layer for the grounded fixed point: when attack edges are added or removed, recompute only the affected region of the label computation rather than the whole graph, exploiting that labels are a pure function of the graph (0e806619395ec8f4). Determinism is preserved because the incremental result must equal a full recomputation, enforced by a deterministic spot-check over a hash-selected edge subset; polynomial cost becomes amortized-polynomial over a batch of edits. The criticizable claim: incremental correctness requires a stable node ordering and tie-breaking rule that the current fixpoint (09ffabcd92979168) does not specify, so the proposal silently adds an order-dependence that must be made explicit and verified.
